title: Microstructure and wear behavior of a refractory high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting of equi-molar mixtures of Mo, Ta, W, Nb, and V elements (purity >99.5%) on a water-cooled copper plate under high-purity argon atmosphere, re-melted five times with flipping between melts (140A initial current, ≤85A subsequent currents)
